title: Add Timeframe Selector to Trade Entry Checker with Timeframe-Adapted Indicators

requirements.summary: Add a Timeframe selector (1m, 15m, 1h) to the Trade Entry Checker form, defaulting to 1m, and display it prominently near the top before indicator inputs.
acceptanceCriteria: The Trade Entry Checker form includes a 'Timeframe' selector with exactly three options: 1m, 15m, 1h.
The default selected timeframe is 1m.
The selected timeframe is visually highlighted (e.g., button group or segmented control).
Changing the timeframe updates the form's indicator labels and hints without clearing already-entered values.

file_operations.description: Add a timeframe state variable (defaulting to '1m') and render a segmented control/button group for selecting 1m, 15m, or 1h at the top of the form, before the asset input. Use shadcn/ui Tabs or ToggleGroup component to provide visual highlighting of the selected timeframe. Ensure the timeframe state is preserved when indicator values change and is reset to '1m' when the form is reset.

requirements.summary: Conditionally render EMA input fields based on selected timeframe: EMA9/EMA21 for 1m; EMA20/EMA50/EMA200 for 15m and 1h. Update field labels accordingly.
acceptanceCriteria: For timeframe=1m: the form shows EMA9 and EMA21 fields only (no EMA50, no EMA200).
For timeframe=15m and 1h: the form shows EMA20, EMA50, and EMA200 fields.
Field labels clearly reflect the EMA period (e.g., 'EMA9', 'EMA21', 'EMA20', etc.).
Switching timeframes updates the visible EMA fields immediately.

file_operations.description: Add conditional rendering logic to the EMA input section based on the timeframe state. For timeframe === '1m', render Input fields labeled 'EMA9' and 'EMA21' with separate state variables (ema9, ema21). For timeframe === '15m' or '1h', render Input fields labeled 'EMA20', 'EMA50', and 'EMA200' using the existing ema20/ema50/ema200 state variables. Store separate state for each EMA period to preserve values when switching timeframes. Update field placeholders and labels to match the EMA period.

requirements.summary: Hide the MACD Direction input for 1m timeframe and display an informational note explaining MACD is not recommended for 1-minute charts. Show MACD for 15m and 1h.
acceptanceCriteria: For timeframe=1m: the MACD Direction dropdown is hidden and replaced with an informational note in English.
For timeframe=15m and 1h: the MACD Direction dropdown is shown as before.
The informational note is short and in English.

file_operations.description: Wrap the MACD Direction Select component in a conditional block. For timeframe === '1m', hide the Select and render an Alert or info Card component (using shadcn/ui Alert) with the message: 'MACD is not recommended for 1m charts due to excessive noise.' For timeframe === '15m' or '1h', display the existing MACD Direction dropdown as normal. Ensure the macdDirection state is preserved for 15m/1h when switching back from 1m.

requirements.summary: Adapt the ATR field behavior and hint based on timeframe: for 1m mark it optional with a specific note; for 15m and 1h keep it required with the standard description.
acceptanceCriteria: For timeframe=1m: ATR field is labeled as optional and displays a note: 'On 1m charts, ATR is only useful as a market activity indicator, not for SL/TP. Leave blank if not available.'
For timeframe=15m and 1h: ATR is required and the standard description is shown.
Validation does not block submission on 1m if ATR is left blank.

file_operations.description: Update the ATR Input field label and helper text based on the timeframe state. For timeframe === '1m', add '(optional)' to the label and display helper text: 'On 1m charts, ATR is only useful as a market activity indicator, not for SL/TP. Leave blank if not available.' For timeframe === '15m' or '1h', use the existing required label and standard ATR description. Adjust the form validation logic to skip ATR requirement when timeframe === '1m'.

requirements.summary: Update the rule engine in tradeEntryRules.ts to evaluate conditions based on the selected timeframe, using different EMA periods, RSI thresholds, and MACD rules for 1m vs 15m/1h.
acceptanceCriteria: For timeframe=1m: rule engine evaluates EMA9/EMA21 alignment, optional ATR proximity to EMA9, and RSI < 75 (Long) / RSI > 25 (Short). MACD is not evaluated.
For timeframe=15m and 1h: rule engine evaluates EMA20 > EMA50 > EMA200 alignment (Long), price within 1× ATR of EMA20, RSI < 65 (Long) / RSI > 35 (Short), and MACD direction.
The checklist in EntryChecklistResults reflects only the applicable conditions for the selected timeframe.
Failed condition explanations reference the correct EMA periods and RSI thresholds for the timeframe.

file_operations.description: Add a new required parameter 'timeframe' (type: '1m' | '15m' | '1h') to the evaluateTradeEntryConditions function signature. Update the function body to branch on timeframe: For '1m': evaluate EMA9 > EMA21 (Long) or EMA9 < EMA21 (Short) alignment; if ATR is provided, check current price is within 1× ATR of EMA9, else skip proximity check; check RSI < 75 (Long) or RSI > 25 (Short); omit MACD condition. For '15m' and '1h': use the existing logic with EMA20 > EMA50 > EMA200, price within 1× ATR of EMA20, RSI < 65 (Long) / > 35 (Short), and MACD direction. Update condition descriptions and explanations to reference the correct EMA periods and RSI thresholds for the selected timeframe. Return only the applicable conditions in the checklist array based on timeframe.

Update the handleSubmit function to pass the selected timeframe and the appropriate EMA values to evaluateTradeEntryConditions. For timeframe === '1m', pass ema9 and ema21 as parameters. For timeframe === '15m' or '1h', pass ema20, ema50, and ema200. Ensure the function call signature matches the updated tradeEntryRules.ts interface and correctly maps form state to the rule engine parameters.

requirements.summary: Display the selected timeframe in the Trade Entry Checker results summary card alongside the asset name and trade direction badge.
acceptanceCriteria: The summary verdict card in EntryChecklistResults shows the timeframe (e.g., '1m', '15m', '1h') as a label or badge.
The timeframe label is always visible when results are displayed.

file_operations.description: Add a new required prop 'timeframe' (type: string) to the EntryChecklistResults component interface. In the summary card header, render the timeframe as a Badge component (using shadcn/ui Badge) positioned near the asset name and direction badge. Use a neutral or secondary badge variant to visually distinguish it from the verdict badge. Ensure the timeframe is always visible when the results component is displayed.

Pass the current timeframe state value as a prop to the EntryChecklistResults component when rendering the results after form submission. Ensure the timeframe prop is always provided and reflects the timeframe used for the evaluation.
